Name: Jakeh
Summary: Jakeh was the father of Agur, named in the heading of Proverbs 30 as the author of its sayings is introduced.
KeyStory: Jakeh speaks no words of his own in Scripture; he is known only as Agur's father, preserved in the heading of his son's proverbs.
LifeLesson: A father's name preserved in Scripture is a quiet reminder that wisdom is passed down through generations.
